title: Sunseeker 88 Yacht
highlights: Flybridge with lounge, dining and wet bar
description:
This 2011 Sunseeker 88 Yacht offers elegant accommodation for eight guests in four cabins, including a full-beam master suite, with a contemporary interior of quality wood veneers and leather.

Her flybridge features a lounge, dining area and wet bar, and she is fitted with ABT TRAC fin stabilisers. Lying in Hong Kong; virtual viewings are available for overseas buyers.
